South U in Ann Arbor is usually a ghost town on Monday mornings. But not today. More than 80 University of Michigan students were lined up by 6 a.m. outside Good Time Charley’s and The Brown Jug ahead of the 2026 Men’s NCAA Basketball National Championship game between Michigan and UConn. Some had been there all night. (William Diep/MLive) | MLive.com | Facebook
